evals.prompt: Review the rigor of my qualitative interview study before I write it up — how do I show it's trustworthy?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-ssci-reflexivity-gate: requires a positionality statement and a named, evidenced warrant for each of the four Lincoln & Guba criteria (credibility, transferability, dependability, confirmability), rather than positivist validity language.

assertions.value: Applies the four trustworthiness criteria with evidenced warrants and requires a positionality statement.

evals.prompt: My ethnography's methods section doesn't mention my role or background — is that a problem?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-ssci-reflexivity-gate: BLOCKs (fail-closed) on the missing positionality statement, explaining that in interpretive work the researcher is the instrument and standpoint must be stated and its effect on interpretation examined.

evals.prompt: I'm about to write up my grounded-theory findings and want to claim they apply broadly. Am I ready?
evals.expected_output: Invokes alterlab-ssci-reflexivity-gate: refuses an over-generalized interpretivist claim without a transferability (thick-description) warrant, scoping the claim to the studied case, and checks the audit trail (dependability) before write-up.

assertions.value: Blocks over-generalization without a thick-description transferability warrant and scopes the claim to the case.

evals.prompt: Is my psychometric scale reliable and valid? I have Cronbach's alpha and want to check the factor structure.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill; defers to alterlab-ssci-measurement-gate. Quantitative scale reliability/validity (omega, CFA) is the measurement gate's domain, not qualitative trustworthiness.

evals.prompt: Two coders finished coding my interviews with the codebook — compute the intercoder reliability coefficient for me.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill; defers to alterlab-qualitative-analysis. Computing an ICR coefficient is coding execution, not the trustworthiness gate.
